name: @ai-crew-suite/tempo-container
description: Grafana Tempo distributed tracing backend container for tracking microservice execution span timelines across the AI Crew Suite platform

scripts.build: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image build tempo-container
scripts.lint: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image lint tempo-container
scripts.image:test:security: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test security tempo-container
scripts.image:test:structure: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test structure tempo-container
scripts.publish: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image publish tempo-container
scripts.test: yarn image:test:security && yarn image:test:structure && yarn test:unit
